zh.help:
已连接 dant。发送文字、图片、文档或语音附件即可提交任务。
/progress 工作进度（也支持 /porgress）
/status 电脑、通话与队列状态
/pause 暂停当前工作和队列，保留通话
/resume [任务 ID] 继续已暂停任务
/stop 仅停止本 Telegram 的任务
/help 帮助
zh.noRunning: 当前没有正在执行的任务
zh.unavailable: 无法确认工作状态，请在 dant 重新连接
zh.voiceFollowup: 请在聊天中重新交办后续工作
zh.receiveError: 消息未能执行。请在 dant 检查任务状态后再决定是否重新提交。
zh.stopSuccess: 已停止此 Telegram 的当前任务，等待你重新决定下一步。
zh.stopNone: 没有可停止的 Telegram 当前任务。桌面任务和通话保持原状。
zh.pauseUsage: 用法：/pause（暂停当前工作及队列，通话保持连接）。
zh.pauseNone: 当前没有可暂停的任务。
zh.pauseSuccess: 工作和队列已暂停，通话保持原状。
zh.pauseUnconfirmed: 尚未确认任务已经暂停，请在 dant 查看工作进度；通话不会由此命令挂断。
zh.connectFirst: 请先在 dant 连接工作电脑。
zh.endSubscription: 请先结束订阅语音通话，再继续已暂停的任务。
zh.activeUnconfirmed: 当前任务仍在执行或状态未确认，请先在 dant 查看工作进度。
zh.resumeNotFound: 没有找到该已暂停或失败的任务，请使用完整任务 ID。
zh.resumeChoose: 有多项已暂停任务，请明确选择：
zh.resumeNone: 没有可继续的已暂停任务。通话任务请在聊天中重新交办。
zh.resumeUnknown: 这个任务的提交结果未确认，不能自动重试。请先在 dant 检查并明确确认重试。
zh.resumeFailed: 任务未能继续，请在 dant 检查任务状态和控制权。
zh.workFinished: 任务已结束，等待你在 dant 验收。
zh.submissionUnknown: 任务提交结果未确认，不会自动重试。请先在 dant 检查。
zh.taskPaused: 任务已暂停，请在 dant 查看。
zh.taskFailed: 任务未能完成，请在 dant 查看。
zh.intakeQueueFull: Telegram 接收队列已达上限，消息未自动重试。
zh.intakeAttachmentFailed: Telegram 附件接收失败，消息未自动重试。
zh.intakePersistenceFailed: Telegram 消息未能保存以供执行，未自动重试。
zh.intakeAdmissionRejected: Telegram 消息未能进入任务队列，未自动重试。
zh.intakeCancelled: Telegram 消息接收已取消，未自动重试。
zh.intakeTimeout: Telegram 消息接收超时，未自动重试。

en.help:
Connected to dant. Send text, photos, documents or voice files to request work.
/progress Shared work progress (also /porgress)
/status Computer, call and queue status
/pause Pause shared work and queue, keep the call
/resume [task ID] Resume a paused task
/stop Stop only this Telegram’s tasks
/help Help
en.unavailable: Work status is unavailable; reconnect in dant
en.voiceFollowup: Continue with a new instruction in chat
en.receiveError: This message could not be executed. Check dant before resubmitting.
en.stopSuccess: This Telegram task stopped. Resume it explicitly in dant if needed.
en.stopNone: No Telegram-owned active task to stop. Desktop work and calls were left alone.
en.pauseUsage: Usage: /pause (pause current work and queue, keep the call).
en.pauseNone: There is no current or queued work to pause.
en.pauseSuccess: Work and queue paused; the call was left unchanged.
en.pauseUnconfirmed: Work has not confirmed it stopped. Check Work progress in dant; this command does not hang up the call.
en.connectFirst: Connect the work computer in dant first.
en.returnControl: Return computer control to dant before resuming.
en.endSubscription: End the subscription call before resuming paused work.
en.activeUnconfirmed: Current work is still active or unconfirmed. Check Work progress in dant first.
en.resumeNotFound: No paused or failed task matches that full task ID.
en.resumeNone: No paused chat task is available. Continue voice-only work with a new chat instruction.
en.resumeUnknown: This task’s submission is unconfirmed and cannot be retried here. Inspect and explicitly confirm a retry in dant.
en.resumeFailed: The task could not resume. Check its state and computer ownership in dant.
en.attachmentPrompt: Please inspect the attached Telegram file.
en.workFinished: Work finished and awaits your review in dant.
en.submissionUnknown: Task submission is unconfirmed and will not be retried. Check dant first.
en.intakeQueueFull: The Telegram intake queue has reached its limit; the message was not retried.
en.intakeAttachmentFailed: The Telegram attachment could not be received; the message was not retried.
en.intakePersistenceFailed: The Telegram message could not be saved for execution; it was not retried.
en.intakeAdmissionRejected: The Telegram message could not enter the task queue; it was not retried.
en.intakeCancelled: Receiving the Telegram message was cancelled; it was not retried.
en.intakeTimeout: Receiving the Telegram message timed out; it was not retried.
